name: Izawa Ruka
source:
The manager of an [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okonomiyaki]okonomiyaki[/url] stand. Ruka often uses a military slang, they say it's because she is secretly a military geek.
She always has a tired face. Can it be that she is tired because of her employees?

[Roughly translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%AB%E3%83%BC%E3%83%B3%E3%83%AD%E3%82%AA%E3%83%89#.E3.81.8A.E5.A5.BD.E3.81.BF.E7.84.BC.E3.81.8D_.E5.AE.87.E5.AE.99.E5.B1.8B]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
